description: This file provides cryptographic utility functions for generating and decrypting organization identifiers based on AES encryption, specifically tailored for a frontend project that interacts with encrypted organization IDs. It defines functions for encryption, decryption, salt validation, and handling hex input for key derivation.

methods.name: hexToWordArray(hex)
methods.description: Converts a hexadecimal string into a CryptoJS WordArray for use as an AES key.

methods.name: generateOrganizationId(email)
methods.description: Generates an encrypted organization ID from an email, using a salt as the AES key and AES-ECB encryption, returning a URL-encoded base64 string.

methods.name: decryptOrganizationId(encUrlEncoded)
methods.description: Decrypts an organization ID (URL-encoded base64 string) back to the original email, using the same salt and AES-ECB decryption.

methods.name: isTenantSaltValid()
methods.description: Checks if the tenant salt is set and non-empty.
